from collections import Counter
def components(g, bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                seen[i][j]=True
                while stack:
                    r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc]!=bg:
                                seen[nr][nc]=True; stack.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(g,bg)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    pat_cells=comps[0]
    rs=[r for r,_ in pat_cells]; cs=[c for _,c in pat_cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0]); cr,cc=ph//2,pw//2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in comps[1:]:
        for r,c in comp:
            out[r][c]=bg  # erase marker first
            for i in range(ph):
                for j in range(pw):
                    nr,nc=r-cr+i,c-cc+j
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W:
                        out[nr][nc]=pat[i][j]
    return out
